Class Cylinder

java.lang.Object
geometries.Geometry
geometries.RadialGeometry
geometries.Tube
geometries.Cylinder
public class Cylinder extends Tube
Represents a finite cylinder in 3D space. A cylinder is defined by its height, a central axis ray, and a radius. Inherits from Tube.

    • Cylinder

      public Cylinder(double height, Ray axis, double radius)
      Constructs a cylinder with a given height, axis, and radius.
      Parameters:
      height - The height of the cylinder. Must be greater than zero.
      axis - The axis ray (central direction and base point)
      radius - The radius of the cylinder. Must be positive.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if height is less than or equal to zero
